headline: Viral farmer Kabir Hossain passed away in Tangail
summary: He gained fame after receiving a 'Farmers Card' from the Prime Minister on April 14, but later faced allegations of being a 'fake farmer'.
details: Kabir Hossain, the farmer from Tangail who went viral after receiving a 'Farmers Card' from Prime Minister Tarique Rahman, has passed away.
He died on Tuesday night after suffering a heart attack at his home in Tartia village, Gharinda Union, Tangail Sadar upazila.
According to family members, he had been experiencing chest pain since Tuesday morning and visited a local clinic for an ECG, which revealed heart issues.
Despite taking medication, the pain returned in the evening, and he collapsed at home. He was later declared dead on arrival at Tangail Medical College Hospital.
Kabir Hossain became a subject of social media discussion on April 14 this year after receiving the card, but was subsequently accused of being a 'fake farmer'.
However, a subsequent investigation by the Department of Agricultural Extension (DAE) confirmed him as a genuine farmer who had been active in agricultural activities for a long time.
State Minister for Fisheries and Livestock and Tangail-5 MP Sultan Salauddin Tuku expressed deep grief and sorrow over his death.
His funeral prayers will be held on Wednesday morning, followed by burial in the local social graveyard.
caption:
The viral farmer from Tangail, once accused of being 'fake' but later proven genuine, has passed away.

Kabir Hossain, the farmer from Tangail who went viral after receiving a 'Farmers Card' from Prime Minister Tarique Rahman, has passed away.

He died on Tuesday night after suffering a heart attack at his home in Tartia village, Gharinda Union, Tangail Sadar upazila.

According to family members, he had been experiencing chest pain since Tuesday morning and visited a local clinic for an ECG, which revealed heart issues.

Despite taking medication, the pain returned in the evening, and he collapsed at home. He was later declared dead on arrival at Tangail Medical College Hospital.

Kabir Hossain became a subject of social media discussion on April 14 this year after receiving the card, but was subsequently accused of being a 'fake farmer'.

However, a subsequent investigation by the Department of Agricultural Extension (DAE) confirmed him as a genuine farmer who had been active in agricultural activities for a long time.

State Minister for Fisheries and Livestock and Tangail-5 MP Sultan Salauddin Tuku expressed deep grief and sorrow over his death.

His funeral prayers will be held on Wednesday morning, followed by burial in the local social graveyard.

headline: Family alleges child died after oxygen line leak at Dhaka hospital
summary: A 4-month-old infant passed away at Shyamoli Baby Care; the father blames a technical failure, while hospital authorities cite post-measles complications.
details: A 4-month-old infant has died at Shyamoli Baby Care, a private paediatric hospital in Dhaka's Shyamoli. The child's father, Mohammad Faruk, alleges that a leak in the hospital's oxygen line caused the death.
caption:
A 4-month-old infant has died in a Dhaka hospital. The father alleges an oxygen line leak caused the tragedy, while the hospital denies any link.

A 4-month-old infant has died at Shyamoli Baby Care, a private paediatric hospital in Dhaka's Shyamoli. The child's father, Mohammad Faruk, alleges that a leak in the hospital's oxygen line caused the death.
